label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 45

obligations.text:
(3)
Where a data subject makes a request under subsection (1), the information to which the data subject is entitled must be provided in writing —
(a)
without undue delay, and
(b)
in any event, before the end of the applicable time period (as to which see section 54).

(5)
Where the rights of a data subject under subsection (1) are restricted under subsection (4), wholly or partly, the controller must inform the data subject in writing without undue delay and in any event before the end of the applicable time period (as to which see section 54)—
(a)
that the rights of the data subject have been restricted,
(b)
of the reasons for the restriction,
(c)
of the data subject's right to make a request to the Commission under section 51,
(ca)
of the data subject’s right to make a complaint to the controller under section 164A,
(d)
of the data subject's right to lodge a complaint with the Commission under section 165, and
(e)
of the data subject's right to apply to

(7)
The controller must—
(a)
record the reasons for a decision to restrict (whether wholly or partly) the rights of a data subject under subsection (1) in reliance on subsection (4), and
(b)
if requested to do so by the Commission, make the record available to the Commission.
